items.title: Isidore Barbarin Interview, 1959-01-07
items.q: I asked him if you know Georgia hookah you know fella by the name of George a hookah

ctx.x: What was his name? What was his name?
His name was back there. George. George was back there.
That's right. He was. He was the best too. Did he know the Teos? Did he know Papa Teo?
